name: andrew designs
author: Andrew Tang
description: Andrew Tang is a product designer at the intersection of design and data, using AI to prototype quickly and designing human-in-the-loop AI workflows.
intro: Hi, I’m Andrew and I work at the **intersection of design + data**, currently designing human-in-the-loop AI workflows that turn data into decisions. My agentified process takes ideas to working prototypes quickly, so I can test assumptions early.
